title: Debiasing CLIP: Interpreting and Correcting Bias in Attention Heads

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating classification performance gaps on datasets where target objects are spuriously correlated with specific backgrounds (e.g., Waterbirds, CounterAnimal), comparing worst-group accuracy (mismatched object-background pairs) to average accuracy.

Measuring the accuracy discrepancy in occupation classification between male and female subjects using the GenderBias-VL dataset, and calculating gender skewness (MaxSkew@K metric) in image retrieval tasks for sensitive attributes using the FairFace dataset.
